sentences.text: This Atlantic bluefin tuna carried its tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Atlantic bluefin tuna are warm-bodied fish that can cross the Atlantic, spawning mainly in the Gulf of Mexico and the Mediterranean.
On {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began: {species_rank_distance}.
